interface: GPIO digital with pull-up, interrupt-timestamped transitions

measurands.name: door_open
measurands.accuracy: state, exact; meaning depends on magnet alignment

failure_modes: reads open forever: fallen or shifted magnet, not necessarily an open door
chatter (rapid transitions): loose door in wind or magnet at threshold distance; debounce in SIM firmware
silent for months is normal; verify liveness via seq heartbeat, never assume
mounting: switch on frame, magnet on the moving leaf, gap under 15 mm when closed
